test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rs. 30000 is lent at compound interest (compounded annually) for 3 years. If the rate of interest is 10 percent for the first year, 20 percent for the second year and 30 percent for the third year, then what will be the total compound interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.30,000

Rate for the first year = 10%

Rate for the second year = 20%

Rate for the third year = 30%

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) = P × {1 + (R/100)} T

Compound Interest (C.I) = (A - P)

Where, P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time

**Calculation:**

Amount (A) = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

⇒ 30000 × {1 + (10/100)} × {1 + (20/100)} × {1 + (30/100)}

 

⇒ 30000 × {1 + (1/10)} × {1 + (1/5)} × {1 + (3/10)}

 

⇒ 30000 × (11/10) × (6/5) × (13/10)

 

⇒ 60 × 11 × 6 × 13 = Rs.51480

 

Compound Interest (C.I) = (A - P)

 

⇒ (51480 - 30000) = Rs.21480

 

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.21480.**
